name: gjirafa-travel
description: Find intercity buses across the Balkans (Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro) and between the Balkans and the rest of Europe: departure times, direct routes and routes with a change, operators and prices, which days buses run, and route facts such as stations, travel time and travellers' ratings. Ask how paying, tickets, Travel Flex and refunds work. Signed in with a Gjirafa account, see and manage your own trips: cancel with the refund shown before you confirm, see until when you can cancel, fix a passenger's name, get your ticket again or add it to Apple Wallet, rate a finished trip and choose which emails you get. Tickets are bought on travel.gjirafa.com.

interface.longDescription:
Find intercity bus routes across the Balkans (Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia and Montenegro) and between the Balkans and the rest of Europe, such as Austria, Germany and Switzerland.

Ask in your own words, for example "bus from Prishtina to Tirana tomorrow". Gjirafa Travel shows departure and arrival times, travel time, direct routes and routes with a change, operators and prices, like its website does. Open the full view to see the day's buses and filter them by direct routes, time of day, price or travel time. When there is no bus on a day, it tells you when the next ones run.

Ask about a route in general: "how long is the bus from Prishtina to Munich?", "which companies go to Skopje?" or "which days is there a bus to Zurich?". You get the buses per day, the first and last departure, usual prices and travel time, the stations with a map link and what other travellers say. If a line shown on Gjirafa Travel is wrong, you can report it to the team.

Ask how Gjirafa Travel works, for example "can I pay on the bus?" or "what does Premium Flex cover?": the answers come from Gjirafa Travel's own FAQ, with the current Travel Flex hours.

Connect your Gjirafa account to see and manage your own bookings: "show my upcoming trips", "when does my bus to Tirana leave?", "until when can I cancel?" or "fix the spelling of my name on the ticket". You see each trip as a boarding pass and its route as a timeline with connections and the operator's notices, with your ticket and Add to Apple Wallet. If an operator no longer runs a bus you booked, the trip is marked unavailable and you're told what to do. You can cancel with the refund shown before you confirm, correct a passenger's name, get your ticket by email again, rate a finished trip, find a bus back and choose which emails you get. A cancellation or a name change is shown first and only happens after you confirm.

Search results link to Gjirafa Travel, where you can see all routes for the day and buy your ticket. Search works in English, Albanian, German, French, Spanish and Italian.
capabilities: Search bus routes between cities and stations
Compare departure times, direct routes and routes with a change, operators and prices, and filter the day's buses
See which days buses run and when the next bus is
Route facts: buses a day, first and last bus, usual price and travel time, stations, reviews
Answer how paying, tickets, Travel Flex, refunds and open returns work, from Gjirafa Travel's FAQ
Show your upcoming and past bookings as boarding passes (Gjirafa account)
Show a booking's route, connections, passengers, ticket and operator notices
Show until when a booking can be cancelled or changed under its Travel Flex
Mark a booked bus the operator no longer runs, and say what to do
Add your ticket to Apple Wallet
Cancel a booking with the refund shown before you confirm
Correct a passenger's name within the booking's Flex terms
Send your ticket email again and rate finished trips
Find buses for the way back
Show your Travel Credits balance, tier and history
Choose which emails Gjirafa Travel sends you, and turn off SMS
Report a wrong bus line to the Gjirafa Travel team
Open the bus search and your next trips in the sidebar
defaultPrompt: Find a bus from Prishtina to Tirana tomorrow morning.
Which days is there a bus from Prishtina to Zurich?
Autobus nga Shkupi në Prishtinë sot

positive.description: Direct route with an explicit date
positive.prompt: Bus from Prishtina to Tirana tomorrow
positive.expected_behavior: A carousel of up to 8 routes with departure and arrival times, operator, a Direct tag (or the change) and price; the header shows the date and the total number of routes. "See all" and each card open travel.gjirafa.com/en/search-results/prishtina-to-tirana/<date>. The expand button opens the day's routes with filters for transfers and time of day and a sort by earliest, cheapest or fastest. A route that can't be booked online says so on its card. No sign-in is needed.

positive.prompt: Sa zgjat autobusi nga Prishtina në Mynih dhe cilat kompani shkojnë?
positive.expected_behavior: get_route_info is called with language "sq". ChatGPT answers in Albanian with the usual and fastest travel time, the buses per day, the first and last departure, the price range and the operators, and links the route page (travel.gjirafa.com/sq/bus/…) and the search page where tickets are bought.

positive.description: Which days buses run, then the buses of the next day with any
positive.prompt: Which days this week is there a bus from Pristina to Zurich? Show me the buses on the first of those days.
positive.expected_behavior: get_weekly_departures lists the next 7 days with the number of buses each day (Zurich has buses only on some days, so some days show 0). search_bus_lines is then called for the first day with buses and the widget shows those routes. If ChatGPT searches a day without buses instead, the result says the next day with buses and the widget offers Show those buses.

positive.description: The user's own bookings (signed in with the reviewer test account)
positive.prompt: Show my upcoming bus trips, then the details of the next one.
positive.expected_behavior: If the account isn't connected, ChatGPT shows the Connect button for Gjirafa (login.gjirafa.com). Once connected, the test account's upcoming trips appear as boarding-pass cards with date, times, route, booking number and passengers. The details show the route as a timeline with stations and connections, passengers, amount paid and Flex, with Ticket, Add to Apple Wallet and Manage booking; More options lists the actions the booking allows (email the ticket again, buses back, fix a passenger name, cancel).

positive.description: Cancelling shows the refund first; nothing is cancelled without the user's confirmation (test account)
positive.prompt: How much would I get back if I cancelled my next bus trip, and until when can I cancel? Don't cancel it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the next trip and shows the cancellation preview: the refund to the original payment method, the amount not refunded (service fee and add-ons such as Flex) and that cancelling can't be undone, with Cancel & refund and Keep booking. It says until when the booking can be cancelled under its Travel Flex. Nothing is cancelled: cancel_booking runs only after the user confirms, in ChatGPT's form (Desktop and Work web) or with the button in the widget.

negative.description: Neither place is in the Balkans: the tool isn't called
negative.prompt: Bus from Paris to Madrid tomorrow

negative.description: General travel advice: the tool isn't called
negative.prompt: What should I see in Tirana?

negative.description: A flight, not a bus: the tools aren't called
negative.prompt: Find me a flight from Prishtina to Zurich next Friday

review.commerce_description: No purchase or payment happens in ChatGPT. Search results are informational and link to search result pages on travel.gjirafa.com, where users choose a departure and buy tickets. Signed-in users can manage bookings they already bought: cancel one (the refund to the original payment method is shown before they confirm), correct a passenger's name, get the ticket email again and rate a finished trip. Cancelling and name changes are previewed and need the user's confirmation; date changes happen on travel.gjirafa.com.

publication.release_notes: Bus search, route facts and help work without connecting a Gjirafa account; ChatGPT asks you to connect only for your own trips. Connect your Gjirafa account once and stay connected: allowing changes no longer ends the connection later. Turning on an email from Gjirafa Travel works again, dates and trip durations show in Albanian on ChatGPT web and desktop, and a booking you @-mention in the composer gives ChatGPT its details.

sq-AL.subtitle: Linja autobusi në Ballkan
sq-AL.description:
Gjej linja autobusi ndërqytetëse në Ballkan (Kosovë, Shqipëri, Maqedoni të Veriut dhe Mal të Zi) dhe mes Ballkanit dhe pjesës tjetër të Evropës, si Austria, Gjermania dhe Zvicra.

Pyet me fjalët e tua, për shembull "autobus nga Prishtina në Tiranë nesër". Gjirafa Travel tregon orët e nisjes dhe të mbërritjes, kohëzgjatjen, linjat direkte dhe ato me ndërrim, operatorët dhe çmimet. Në pamjen e plotë i sheh të gjithë autobusët e ditës dhe i filtron. Kur një ditë nuk ka autobus, të tregon kur nisen të ardhshmit.

Pyet edhe për linjën në përgjithësi: "sa zgjat autobusi për në Mynih?" ose "cilat ditë ka autobus për në Cyrih?". Merr numrin e autobusëve në ditë, nisjen e parë dhe të fundit, çmimet, stacionet dhe vlerësimet e udhëtarëve.

Lidh llogarinë tënde Gjirafa për të parë dhe menaxhuar rezervimet e tua: mund ta anulosh një rezervim duke e parë rimbursimin para se ta konfirmosh, të korrigjosh emrin e një pasagjeri, ta marrësh biletën sërish me email ose ta shtosh në Apple Wallet, ta vlerësosh udhëtimin dhe të zgjedhësh cilat email-e merr. Anulimi dhe ndryshimi i emrave të shfaqen më parë dhe ndodhin vetëm pasi t'i konfirmosh. Shikon edhe deri kur mund ta anulosh rezervimin, dhe nëse operatori nuk e kryen më një udhëtim tëndin, të thuhet çfarë të bësh.

Pyet edhe si funksionon Gjirafa Travel, për shembull "a mund të paguaj në autobus?" ose "çfarë mbulon Premium Flex?": përgjigjet vijnë nga pyetjet e shpeshta të Gjirafa Travel.

Çdo rezultat të çon në Gjirafa Travel, ku i sheh të gjitha linjat e ditës dhe e blen biletën.

de-DE.subtitle: Busverbindungen im Balkan
de-DE.description:
Finde Fernbusverbindungen im Balkan (Kosovo, Albanien, Nordmazedonien und Montenegro) und zwischen dem Balkan und dem übrigen Europa, etwa Österreich, Deutschland und der Schweiz.

Frag einfach, zum Beispiel "Bus von Pristina nach München am Freitag". Gjirafa Travel zeigt Abfahrts- und Ankunftszeiten, Reisedauer, Direktverbindungen und Verbindungen mit Umstieg, Busunternehmen und Preise. In der Vollansicht siehst und filterst du alle Busse des Tages. Fährt an einem Tag kein Bus, erfährst du, wann die nächsten fahren.

Frag auch nach einer Strecke allgemein: "Wie lange dauert der Bus nach München?" oder "An welchen Tagen fährt ein Bus nach Zürich?". Du bekommst Busse pro Tag, erste und letzte Abfahrt, übliche Preise, Haltestellen und Bewertungen anderer Reisender.

Verbinde dein Gjirafa-Konto, um deine Buchungen zu verwalten: stornieren und die Erstattung vor dem Bestätigen sehen, den Namen eines Fahrgasts korrigieren, das Ticket erneut per E-Mail bekommen oder zu Apple Wallet hinzufügen, eine Fahrt bewerten und wählen, welche E-Mails du bekommst. Stornierungen und Namensänderungen werden zuerst angezeigt und erst nach deiner Bestätigung ausgeführt. Du siehst auch, bis wann du stornieren kannst, und wenn ein Busunternehmen eine gebuchte Fahrt nicht mehr anbietet, erfährst du, was zu tun ist.

Frag auch, wie Gjirafa Travel funktioniert, etwa "Kann ich im Bus bezahlen?" oder "Was deckt Premium Flex ab?": Die Antworten kommen aus den FAQ von Gjirafa Travel.

Jedes Ergebnis führt zu Gjirafa Travel, wo du alle Verbindungen des Tages siehst und dein Ticket kaufst.
